title: Compact Session Folding Lab
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Learning Analytics
xAPI
LRS-Lite
Producer-Side Summarization
description: Drive a small practice MicroSim and watch the same interactions arrive as separate statements in Full mode but fold into one session summary in Compact mode, while checked answers pass through unfolded.
audience: Teachers, instructional designers, learning-technology developers and learning-analytics practitioners (college undergraduate and professional development)

educational.topic: Compact mode session summaries and loss-of-focus events
learningObjectives: The learner will distinguish which interactions Compact mode folds into a session summary, which pass through as their own statements, and which Loss of Focus Event ends the session.
prerequisites: xAPI verbs interacted, experienced and answered (Chapter 16)

accessibility.notes: Native p5 DOM controls (slider, buttons, radio) are keyboard operable; describe() provides a screen-reader description. Statement tooltips need a pointer.

controls.label: Gravity
controls.note: deadband of 1 unit: every step is one Full-mode statement

keyQuestions: Which events fold into the session and which pass through?
Why does an answer never change statements_represented?
Why does Idle not fire while the sim is running?
commonMisconceptions: That leaving the page emits something extra in Full mode
That a session opened only by an answer emits nothing
assessmentOpportunities: Predict both statement counts for a described sequence
Name the loss-of-focus event that closed a session

simulation.modelType: event-driven model of the compact session runtime
assumptions: A run still in progress is closed (and emitted in Full mode) when a focus-loss signal ends the session
end_reason strings other than scrolled-away are illustrative
limitations: Timing (active_ms, session_ms, duration) is not modelled
Only one practice control of each kind
